options.name: tabs
options.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; icon?: IconRef; disabled?: boolean; content?: Node | string }[]
options.description: Tabs in order. Ids must be unique; they are consumer keys, not DOM ids.

options.name: value
options.description: Selected tab id. Default: the first enabled tab.

options.name: activation
options.description: automatic selects on focus; manual needs Enter or Space.

options.name: orientation
options.description: Layout and arrow keys (Left/Right or Up/Down).

options.name: direction
options.description: Mirrors Left/Right in rtl. An ancestor dir=rtl also mirrors.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

methods.name: panel
methods.description: The tabpanel for a tab id, for consumers to fill.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options. Panels are kept by id.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, observers, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user selected a different tab.

contentAreas.name: panel
contentAreas.description: One tabpanel per tab: tabs.panel(id), or the tab's `content` option.
